name: mern-student-base
description: Run both apps from the repository root.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SH,BE,FE -c green,blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix shared" "npm run dev --prefix BE" "npm run dev --prefix FE"
scripts.test: npm run build --prefix shared && npm test --prefix shared && npm test --prefix BE && npm test --prefix FE
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix BE && npm run build --prefix FE
